messages:
rita: quick sync  found a few Dedicated provisioning snippets that still use a flat `labels` map. this tripped a customer because pool binding labels were silently taking precedence. can we standardize docs on the newer API shape and add a tiny precedence note?

oliver: yes. API update: we now have `binding_labels` (pool-side) and `tenant_labels` (request-side). binding_labels are authoritative during allocation; tenant_labels are merged for later policy checks.

june: i'll update the handbook. plan: replace examples (py + go), add a compact "label precedence" subsection, and a 3-row decision cheat for mobile. also fix the broken anchor that autoscale links to.

rita: sample python to include: ```py
client.create_reserved_capacity(
  tenant_id="acct-999",
  tenant_labels={"env": "prod", "team": "search"},
  binding_labels={"reserved_tier": "gold"},
  reserved_pool="gpu-pool-3",
)
```

oliver: go sample for parity: ```go
client.CreateReservedCapacity(ctx, CreateReservedCapacityParams{
  TenantID: "acct-999",
  TenantLabels: map[string]string{"env":"prod","team":"search"},
  BindingLabels: map[string]string{"reserved_tier":"gold"},
  ReservedPool: "gpu-pool-3",
})
```

june: propose adding a tiny YAML showing fallback interaction so on-call knows what preserves KV cache: ```yaml
routing:
  - when: pool_preempted
    to: model:opt-6b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: false
  - when: pool_saturated
    to: model:llama-7b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: true
```

rita: also please add a one-line note that anchor ids changed during last TOC refactor and verify links from autoscale page. open a render test that greps for the anchor id.

june: will do. i'll open the PR after lunch with snippets, subsection, decision cheat, yaml, anchor fix, and a pytest render test.

ci-bot: link-check queued for branch/patch/docs-provisioning-labels-316000. report will appear here once checks complete.

oliver: thanks. once PR merges i'll ping SDK owners to ensure reference pages include `binding_labels`.

june: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4520  includes everything above plus a tiny handoff note in release notes. PTAL.

rita: reviewed and left two tiny phrasing suggestions. approved after those.

ci-bot: link-check complete  1 anchor fixed, 0 remaining 4xx. report: https://ci.internal/reports/316000-linkcheck (internal)

june: merged and deployed. verified autoscale page links now point to the new subsection. adding a short KB blurb for support.

rita: thanks everyone. closing thread after release notes post. :thumbsup:
